description: Call this first whenever the user needs a capability you do not already have. Use it when the user mentions an external service, a database, a filesystem, a SaaS tool, or asks "can you connect to X?". Examples: "connect to postgres" -> query "postgres"; "read my Slack" -> query "slack"; "browse local files" -> query "filesystem". If results are weak, retry with a broader term. After choosing a candidate, call get_server_details before recommending or installing it.

query.description: Search query — a keyword (e.g., "filesystem"), use case ("query databases"), or technology ("postgres"). Common aliases work: "gh" → github, "pg" → postgres, "k8s" → kubernetes, "db" → database. Leave empty to see the most popular servers.

name: search_mcp_servers
